column1: AI suggestions that continue a T-SQL statement as you type are called {{c1::code completions}}.
column2:
In VS Code, inline completions use editor context, not the connected database schema.

column1: Converting a plain-language data request into T-SQL is called {{c1::natural language to SQL}}.
column2:
The generated query is a starting point for review.

column2:
This capability helps interpret existing stored procedures and queries.

column2:

column2:
